title: Whelk
summary: WHELK, noun 1. A wrinkle; inequality on the surface; protuberance; a pustule. [See Welk and Weal.] 2. A shell of the genus Bussinum, or trumpetshell, univalvular, spiral and gibbous, with an oval aper

inlines.v: WHELK, noun 1. A wrinkle; inequality on the surface; protuberance; a pustule. [See Welk and Weal.] 2. A shell of the genus Bussinum, or trumpetshell, univalvular, spiral and gibbous, with an oval aperture ending in a short canal or gutter.
